biotools.summary: XPRS is a software tool designed to enhance the interpretability of polygenic risk scores by decomposing them into gene/region and SNP contribution scores using Shapley Additive Explanations. The tool features a user-friendly web interface and provides multilevel visualizations for data input and interpretation.
